comparison.objective: Complete a wire splice with a twist-on connector; candidate preassembles machining-tool components.
comparison.physical_skill: Even flexible wire tips and rotate a threaded/helical connector to snugness versus rigid groove-to-lip alignment and snap seating.
comparison.success_condition: Tug-resistant, covered, snug splice with hands released versus collet retained without threading or destructive pull.
comparison.reason: Rotation and retention are generic similarities only; the physical abilities and verification tests differ.
